title: A headless OMP agent that asks for approval is inert, exits 0, and invites a redispatch loop

incident.mechanism: approvalMode: write on a headless agent -> every exec-tier tool fails 'requires approval but no interactive UI available' -> run exits 0 and is recorded succeeded -> issue left in_progress with no disposition -> successful-run handoff creates a corrective run -> repeat, bounded only by the budget cap

guardAddedBy: this case — the failure had no guard before 2026-09-02, only a prose note in omp/engineer.policy.yml and a config that happened to say yolo
trigger: an omp_local agent declaring approvalMode other than yolo
assertion: config load refuses, naming the agent and the incident
